Our Walchand 🥹🫶🏻

for the people who made it home

Sometimes, it feels so good to sit back and relive those memories… 🥹❤️‍🩹✨

That confidence, those library stairs pe gossips, roz lunch break mein ek ferftka to library stairs 😭😂, labs ke time ek dusre ke saath woh stupid harkatein, Joshi sir ke paas components lene jaane wale din, HOD cabin ke bahar hours tak chalne wali meetings 😭🤌🏻

Those GREAT WALCHAND memories 🫶🏻🥹

Your hostel stay, those late-night gossips, and our endless bakchodi… nobody could ever match our vibes, fr. 😭💗 We knew every single thing happening around us, but saamne se aise act karte the jaise humein kuch pata hi nahi. 🤡😂

Capstone project wale din, woh hum teeno ka ek saath bench pe baithna, Sairam ki coffee that could fix literally ANY mood ☕😭, Lipton pe baithna, gathering wale din, aur pagaloon ki tarah naachna. 💃🏻🪩

Kabhi kabhi lagta hai, yaar, kyun nahi jee liye us Walchand mein kuch aur din? 🥹❤️‍🩹

Maine toh kabhi socha bhi nahi tha ki itne kam saalon mein itni saari memories ban jayengi, aur hum itne zyada close ho jayenge. 🫂💗 From being random people to becoming my people… the journey feels unreal.

Mujhe aaj bhi yaad hai woh din jab hum pehli baar us Xerox shop pe mile the… phir Tilak Hall… wahi se toh hamari baatein shuru hui thi. 🥹❤️ From the initial “What’s your name?” to the countless conversations, endless gossip sessions, stupid fights, random laughs, and “bhul mat jaana” wali bonding… pata hi nahi chala ki yeh journey kab shuru hui aur kab itni special ban gayi. 🫶🏻✨

Walchand gave us a degree, but somewhere along the way, it also gave us a little world of our own. 🥹🫂❤️

And honestly, no matter where life takes us, no matter how busy we get, and no matter how much things change… a part of me will always miss those days, those places, and those versions of us. 🥺

Some friendships don’t need daily conversations to stay alive… because some memories are too beautiful to ever fade. ♾️❤️‍🩹

Missing Walchand, but missing OUR Walchand even more. 🥹🫶🏻🏫❤️‍🔥

Pata woh industrial training wale din 😭❤️‍🩹, our group was small but never incomplete 🫂🤌🏻

Pure class mein bahut friendships dekhi, but hamari wali thodi alag thi yaar 🥹🫶🏻. Kabhi humare beech mein koi bada jhagda nahi hua, na kabhi aisa laga ki kuch bolne se pehle sochna padega ki saamne wale ko bura toh nahi lagega 😭😭❤️

Jo mann mein aaya, bol diya… bina filter, bina overthinking, bina kisi hesitation ke. 😂🤌🏻 Mann mein jo tha, woh bol dete the, because there was never that fear of “yaar, yeh kya sochega?” 🫂💗

Pure 3 years saath bitaye, and honestly, kabhi aisa feel hi nahi hua ki hum alag-alag log hain. Ek dusre ko samajhne ke liye explanations nahi chahiye the 😭😂. Bas apni hi duniya thi, apne hi rules, apni hi bakchodi. 🫠❤️‍🔥

Aur woh PURE VISITS TOH BHAIIIIIIII 😭😭😭🤌🏻🤌🏻🤌🏻 — alag hi level ka pagalpan tha! Us visit ki apni story, har din ka apna scene, aur har memory aisi ki aaj yaad karo toh hasi bhi aati hai aur aankhein bhi bhar aati hain. 🥹💗

Sach mein, friendship toh bahut logon se hoti hai, but aisi comfort, aisi understanding aur aisi बेफिक्री baar-baar nahi milti. 🫂♾️

Aaj lagta hai, humne sirf college ke 3 years nahi jiye the… humne apni life ke kuch sabse beautiful moments jiye the, bina yeh jaane ki ek din inhi moments ko itna miss karenge. 🥺❤️‍🩹

Small group, unlimited memories, zero filters, and a bond that will always be different. 🧿❤️🫶🏻

Kabhi kabhi toh aisa lagta hai yaar ki aap sab bhool toh nahi jaoge na 🥹❤️‍🩹 ki hum kabhi itne close hua karte the… woh chhoti chhoti baatein, woh pagalpan, woh bina soche kuch bhi bol dena, woh har baat pe hasna 😭🫂

Pata nahi aage life kahan le jaayegi, kitne naye log milenge, kitni responsibilities aa jayengi… bas darr sa lagta hai ki kahin waqt ke saath humari yeh memories dhundhli na pad jaayein. 🥺

Main toh nahi bhool paungi yaar… bas kabhi kabhi mann karta hai ki aap bhi mujhe aur humare in dino ko aise hi yaad rakho, jaise humne saath mein jiye the. 🫶🏻❤️‍🩹♾️

and Sakshi’s birthday wish for Vede 🎂💗

🔒 One more message is waiting, only for one person…

Tumhe pata haiii… tumhari woh awaaz, mujhe “Vede” kehkar bulana 🥹❤️‍🩹, aaj bhi main bahut miss karti hoon yaarrr. Woh apnapan tha na tumhari baaton mein, woh ab kahin aur nahi milta. 🫂❤️

Aaj bhi jab kabhi Sangli ke stand par jaati hoon na, toh sabse pehle tumhari hi yaad aati hai. Pata nahi kyun, par us jagah se bhi tumhari kitni saari memories judi hui hain. 🥺

Aaj yeh sab tumhe bolne ka mann kiya, pata nahi kyun… shayad photos dekhte dekhte dil mein jo itne din se tha, woh sab bahar aa gaya. Har photo ke saath ek alag memory yaad aati hai, woh din, woh baatein, woh hasi, woh apnapan… aur phir realize hota hai ki yaar, kitna kuch peeche chhoot gaya. 😭❤️‍🩹

Abhi bhi yeh sab likhte waqt aankhon se paani aa raha hai. Pata nahi kaise samjhaun tumhe ki humari friendship mere liye kitni special thi. Humne sirf friendship nahi ki thi yaar, humne ek dusre ke saath apna ek alag hi world banaya tha… jahan bina soche kuch bhi bol sakte the, bina kisi hesitation ke apne mann ki har baat keh sakte the. 🫂🧿

Aur shayad isi liye aaj itna yaad aata hai sab… kyunki humari friendship koi aisi-vaisi friendship nahi thi. Woh comfort, woh apnapan, woh haq se bulana, woh bina kisi reason ke ek dusre ko yaad karna… sab kuch alag tha. 🥹🫶🏻

Pata nahi tumhe bhi kabhi meri yaad aati hai ya nahi, par main aaj bhi tumhe aur humare un dino ko utna hi apna maanti hoon. ❤️‍🩹

Bas kabhi aisa mat sochna ki waqt ke saath sab bhool jayenge. Kuch log aur kuch rishte life mein itni gehri jagah bana lete hain na, ki unse door hone ke baad bhi woh dil ke bahut paas rehte hain.

Aur tum unhi logon mein se ho, Vede… 🥹❤️🫂♾️
